features.title: High-back comfort that supports you fully
features.text: Designed to support your entire upper body, Chubby’s elevated backrest gently cradles the shoulders and back. Its ergonomic build adapts to your posture, offering reliable lumbar support that makes long hours of sitting feel effortless.

features.title: Plush seating you can sink into
features.text: Layered cushioning and a voluminous profile come together to create an indulgent seating experience. The generously padded seat invites you to relax fully, delivering a cocoon-like comfort that balances softness with lasting support.

features.title: Curved armrests for relaxed lounging
features.text: The rounded armrests are shaped for natural comfort, supporting your arms while encouraging laid-back lounging. Their smooth curves blend seamlessly into the sofa’s silhouette, giving it a fluid, cohesive form that feels gentle and intuitive.

features.title: Modern design defined by soft lines
features.text: Chubby embraces contemporary design through rounded edges and bold proportions. Its sculpted form makes a statement without sharpness, bringing a sense of warmth and approachability to modern interiors.

features.title: Elevated look and feel
features.text: Set on elevated legs, the sofa offers ample ground clearance that makes cleaning underneath easy while adding a light, elevated look to the overall design.

features.title: Soft-touch upholstery with structured accents
features.text: Upholstered in premium microfibre fabric, Chubby offers a smooth, velvety feel that’s gentle on the skin and easy to maintain. Synthetic leather detailing along the sides adds a tailored contrast, enhancing durability while giving the sofa a polished, layered finish.
